gallery.title: Interactive Lab | Holistic Tech Solutions Group
gallery.description: Play Agency Invaders, Launch Runner, and Trivia Challenge. Three browser games with cinematic worlds, keyboard and touch controls, and Halo.

play.title: Play three games | HTSG Interactive Lab
play.description: Defend against project chaos, double-jump with Halo, or test your digital know-how. Choose from three games in the HTSG Interactive Lab.

invaders.title: Agency Invaders | HTSG Interactive Lab
invaders.description: Fly around scope creep, missed deadlines, and budget overruns. Steer, fire, and protect your launch in Agency Invaders.

runner.title: Launch Runner | HTSG Interactive Lab
runner.description: Double-jump with Halo across a futuristic launch complex. Clear barriers, collect energy, and keep moving in Launch Runner.

trivia.title: Trivia Challenge | HTSG Interactive Lab
trivia.description: Explore three five-question rounds about strategy, design, and trust. Choose an answer, learn why it works, and build a streak.
